summary: Traccar is a Java-based application designed to receive and record GPS positions from various remote tracking hardware. It includes mobile apps for Android and iOS alongside a web interface to inspect recorded trips and locations. The system processes incoming data streams from multiple vendor protocols into a centralised map view.
goodFor: Self-hosters who need a central platform to collect and visualise location telemetry from multiple physical GPS tracking devices or mobile phones.
watchOut: You will need to configure specific device communication protocols correctly, and unfamiliarity with hardware integration can make initial troubleshooting tedious.
deployNotes: Because this application runs on Java and handles persistent telemetry data, you will typically need to provision a dedicated database backend and place it behind a reverse proxy for TLS termination.
